e2ee.conflict.title: Sync conflict — {path}
e2ee.conflict.body: This note was also changed on another device. Choose what to keep; it is not synced until you decide.
e2ee.setup.title: Encrypted sync
e2ee.setup.note: Notes are encrypted on this device before upload; the sync service sees only ciphertext. A lost passphrase cannot be recovered.
e2ee.fresh.unverified: Freshness not verified: this device cannot yet tell whether the sync service shows your newest notes. Pair it with a device you already use, or confirm after checking.
e2ee.fresh.badCode: This pairing code is not valid for this vault, or it has expired.
e2ee.fresh.olderKeys: The other device is at a newer key epoch than this one sees: the sync service may be showing this device old keys. Sync both devices and try again; if it stays like this, don't trust this service.
e2ee.sync.title: Sync
e2ee.sync.provider: Where to keep the encrypted vault
e2ee.sync.kind.s3: S3-compatible storage (AWS, Cloudflare R2, Backblaze B2, MinIO)
e2ee.sync.oauthMissing: Not available in this build: it needs Lumen's {name} app id, which is not configured.
e2ee.sync.pathStyle: Path-style addresses (MinIO and most self-hosted servers)
e2ee.sync.keepSecret: Leave empty to keep the saved one
e2ee.sync.cors: Lumen could not reach {host}. The server must allow this site (CORS, and expose the ETag header); a self-hosted Lumen must also list it in VITE_CSP_CONNECT_EXTRA.
e2ee.sync.unsupported: This server cannot do safe concurrent writes, so Lumen will not sync with it: {detail}
e2ee.sync.newVault: There is no vault there yet. Choose a passphrase to create it.
e2ee.sync.existingVault: A vault is already there. Enter its passphrase.
e2ee.sync.disconnectNote: Forgets the provider on this device. Nothing at the provider is deleted.
e2ee.sync.pairCodeNote: Enter it on the other device within 2 minutes. It proves to that device which state is current; this device changes no keys meanwhile. Pairing from the new device's request (two-way) is safer.
e2ee.sync.migrate.title: Readable notes from an earlier Lumen
e2ee.sync.migrate.found: {n} unencrypted notes are in your {name} folder. Import them into the encrypted vault; the readable copies are moved into a backup folder at {name}, not deleted.
e2ee.sync.migrate.clashes: {n} of them differ from notes here; both versions are kept.
e2ee.sync.migrate.done: Imported {n} notes. The readable copies are in “{folder}” at {name}; delete that folder yourself when you are satisfied.
e2ee.sync.migrate.revert: Undo: move the readable copies back
e2ee.activity.title: Activity
e2ee.activity.empty: Nothing yet. The list fills as the sync works.
e2ee.activity.summary: {synced} synced · {pending} waiting · {conflict} conflicts · {error} errors · {excluded} kept on this device
e2ee.activity.held.clash: A file and a folder share this name: {path}
e2ee.rules.title: What syncs on this device
e2ee.rules.note: Saved on this device only. Files left out stay here and are never sent; newer versions from other devices are not downloaded, and deletions are not applied.
e2ee.rules.folders: Folders to leave out (one per line)
e2ee.rules.extensions: File types to leave out (e.g. mp4, mov)
e2ee.rules.maxSize: Largest attachment to sync, in MB (empty: no limit)
e2ee.rules.saved: Saved. Applies from the next sync.
e2ee.bg.didNotRun: Sync did not run while Lumen was in the background ({minutes} min). Syncing now.
e2ee.bg.didNotRunNative: iOS and Android pause Lumen in the background, so sync did not run for {minutes} min. Syncing now.
e2ee.bg.locked: Sync is paused while the vault is locked ({minutes} min). Unlock it to sync.
e2ee.sync.kind.lan: Local network: another device here, no cloud
e2ee.lan.role.host: Keeps the vault: other devices pair with it
e2ee.lan.role.peer: Joins a device that keeps the vault
e2ee.lan.note: Devices connect directly. Nothing goes to the internet, so this works with none at all.
e2ee.lan.where.host: Local network: this device keeps the vault
e2ee.lan.where.peer: Local network: paired with a device here
e2ee.lan.join.title: Join a device on this network
e2ee.lan.join.paste: The code from the hosting device (Sync → Pair a device on this network)
e2ee.lan.join.showBack: Show this code to the hosting device (or paste it there):
e2ee.lan.pair: Pair a device on this network
e2ee.lan.hostNote: Keep Lumen open on this device while the others sync. The vault stays on your local network.
e2ee.lan.pair.show: On the other device, choose Local network → Joins a device, and enter this code (scan it, or paste it):
e2ee.lan.qr: QR code of the pairing code
e2ee.lan.noVault: The hosting device has no vault yet. Create it there first, then join.
e2ee.lan.notConnected: Not connected to the hosting device. Pair the two devices again.
e2ee.lan.authFailed: The other device isn't part of this vault (a different passphrase).
e2ee.lan.error.no-webrtc: This browser can't make a direct link (WebRTC is off).
e2ee.lan.error.bad-code: That isn't a Lumen pairing code, or part of it is missing.
e2ee.lan.error.wrong-code: That code is from the wrong step: the host shows the first code, the joining device the answer.
e2ee.lan.error.no-lan-address: No local-network address on one of the devices. Are both on the same network?
e2ee.lan.error.not-lan: The other end isn't on the local network, so the link was closed.
e2ee.lan.error.timeout: The other device didn't connect in time. Make a new code and try again.
e2ee.guide.title: Sync in two clicks
e2ee.guide.whereIntro: Your notes are encrypted on this device before they leave it. Choose where the encrypted copy is kept; the best place for this device is already chosen.
e2ee.guide.whereTitle: Where to keep the encrypted copy
e2ee.guide.where.folder: A folder of iCloud Drive, Dropbox, Google Drive or OneDrive
e2ee.guide.where.folder.about: Pick the folder your sync app already syncs on this computer. Lumen puts only encrypted files there, in “Lumen sync”.
e2ee.guide.where.relay.about: Works on phones and every browser. The relay stores only encrypted files and can't read them.
e2ee.guide.where.webdav.about: Your own server: its address, user name and password.
e2ee.guide.webdavUrl: The address must start with https://
e2ee.guide.advanced: Advanced: S3, Dropbox, Google Drive and every detail
e2ee.guide.keyIntro: This is your sync key: 13 words. Write them down or keep them in your password manager. Every other device needs them.
e2ee.guide.lossWarning: Without these words nobody can open the encrypted copy — not you on a new device, not Lumen. If you lose them and this device, the synced copy is lost. Your notes on this device stay.
e2ee.guide.checkAsk: To show you saved them, type word number {n}:
e2ee.guide.joinAsk: Paste or type the 13 words from your first device:
e2ee.guide.haveKey: I already have a key from another device
e2ee.guide.wordUnknown: Word {n} isn't one of the key's words. Check its spelling.
e2ee.guide.wordCheck: One of the words is wrong (the last word checks the others).
e2ee.guide.checkWrong: Word {n} doesn't match. Look at the list again.
e2ee.guide.existing: This place already holds a synced vault. Enter the 13 words from the device that set it up.
e2ee.guide.wrongKey: These words don't open the vault in this place.
e2ee.guide.done: Syncing is on. Every file's state:
e2ee.guide.secondDevice: On your next device: open Lumen, run “Set up sync”, choose the same place and paste the 13 words.
e2ee.class.title: Private classroom
e2ee.class.intro: Hand out a template, collect sealed work, send comments back. Only the teacher opens a student's work, only that student opens the teacher's comments; the relay holds sealed boxes it cannot read.
e2ee.class.create: New assignment from the open note
e2ee.class.noRelay: This build has no relay (VITE_SYNC_RELAY_URL). A school can run its own on the school network: see the docs, "Private classroom".
e2ee.class.linkNote: Send this link to the class. It holds the template and what is needed to hand in, not your key: only this device can open the work.
e2ee.class.closeConfirm: Delete every submission and comment of "{title}" from the relay? Copies you opened into tabs stay.
e2ee.class.commentSent: Sent — only this student can open it.
e2ee.class.notHandedIn: Not handed in yet. Your copy stays on this device until you hand it in.
e2ee.class.commentsAdded: {n} new comments added to the open note
e2ee.class.otherRelay: This link uses another relay ({relay}) than this copy of Lumen. Ask your teacher for a link from your school's Lumen.
e2ee.class.yourName: Your name (only the teacher sees it)
e2ee.class.joinNote: You get your own copy of the template in a new tab. Nothing is sent until you choose "Hand in".
e2ee.class.error.link.malformed: This classroom link is broken or incomplete.
e2ee.class.error.link.tooLarge: The note is too large for a classroom link (32 KB).
e2ee.class.error.link.unsupported: This browser cannot open classroom links.
e2ee.fresh.held: Until then, changes made on this device stay on it and are not uploaded: it can't tell yet whether it has the vault's latest keys, and a device removed meanwhile could read what it uploads.
e2ee.fresh.requestHint: Enter this request on a device you already use. It checks it against the vault as it is now and shows an answer: enter that answer above.
e2ee.pair.answerTitle: Pairing request from a new device
e2ee.pair.stale: The new device is being shown older keys than this one has: the sync service may be showing it an old state. Don't pair it; sync it and try again, and if it stays like this, don't trust this service.
e2ee.pair.pending: A pairing code from this device is still valid, so it makes no key change for now: a device paired with that code wouldn't learn of the change. Try again in a couple of minutes.
e2ee.rekey.unconfirmed: The revocation may not have taken effect: right after this key change was written, the sync service returned another device's instead (it ignored a conditional write). Sync this device: it revokes again, or says why it can't. If this happens again, don't use this service for key changes.
e2ee.fork.reapplied: The sync service replaced this device's key change with another device's. The revocation may not have taken effect for what was written in between; this device has made it again. Sync every device, and don't use this service for key changes.
e2ee.wrap.tampered: This device's key in the vault's keyring doesn't open it: the sync service changed it or put back an old one. Nothing on this device was changed. Try again later; if it stays like this, pair this device again from one you trust.
e2ee.pair.answerHint: Paste the request the new device shows. This device checks it against the vault as it is now; enter the answer on the new device within 5 minutes.
e2ee.drive.syncOnly: Google Drive can't refuse a second "create" of the same file atomically, so with Drive this vault syncs, but keys and devices can't be changed here (no re-key, no revocation, no new device key). Make those changes with another storage, or move the vault.
e2ee.drive.limits: With Google Drive, you can't remove a lost device or change a leaked passphrase in this vault. To do either, move the vault to WebDAV, S3 or Dropbox first.
e2ee.pair.cancelled: Pairing cancelled: this device can change keys again. Don't use that answer or code on the other device; pair it again after the key change.
e2ee.fork.refused: The sync service returned keys that don't follow from the ones this device verified, so this device stopped (nothing on it was changed). Don't change keys or add devices until every device agrees; pair this device again from one you trust.
e2ee.fork.atRisk: The sync service returned keys that don't follow from the ones this device verified, and they may let back in a device you removed here. This device stopped; nothing on it was changed. Once every device agrees, remove that device again from a device you trust, and don't use this service for key changes.
e2ee.dropped: This device wasn't carried over to the vault's new keys: either a device that couldn't verify the vault's device list changed them, or this device was removed. Nothing on it was changed. To use it with the vault again, unlock it with the passphrase, or pair it from a device you trust (as a new device, if it was removed).
e2ee.revoked: This device was removed from the vault, so it can't open the current keys. The notes already on it stay.
e2ee.rekey.dropConfirm: This device can't verify it has the vault's latest keys, so a key change from it would leave out {devices}: they would have to be paired again. Pair this device from one you trust first, or confirm to leave them out.
e2ee.rekey.busy: Another device is changing the vault's keys right now. Sync, and try again once it has finished (10 minutes at most).
e2ee.pair.rekeying: This device is changing the vault's keys right now. Make the pairing code once the change has finished.
e2ee.revokedHere.reset: This device's own list of the devices it removed couldn't be verified, so it was set aside. It now checks against the vault's sealed list of removed devices. Check the device list on a device you trust.
e2ee.rekey.contested: Removing {devices} didn't go through, again: each time, the vault's device list was rewritten at the same moment by something that still has the vault's keys and the storage login, most likely the device you're removing. Change the storage password or token first, so that device can't write any more, then remove it again.
e2ee.lan.visibleAs: Also visible on this network as {name}: on the other device, choose Find devices on this network and pick it.
e2ee.lan.found.none: No device found. On the hosting device, start Pair a device and keep the dialog open, or use the code below.
e2ee.lan.discovery.used: That device already paired with another one. Start a new pairing there.
e2ee.lan.discovery.failed: Couldn't reach that device. Use the code below instead.
e2ee.lan.compare.title: Comparison code
e2ee.lan.compare.ask: Check that the other device shows this same code next to this device before you continue:
e2ee.lan.compare.mismatch: The codes differed, so the link was closed. Pair again; if it happens again, another device on this network may be in between.
e2ee.lan.found.duplicate: Two devices announce {name}. Pick one only if, after pairing, both screens show the same code.
e2ee.sas.title: Compare the symbols
e2ee.sas.prompt: Do these five symbols, in this order, match the ones on the other device?
e2ee.sas.waitingKey: Waiting for the other device… Keep both devices open.
e2ee.sas.waitingConfirm: Confirmed on this device. Now choose “They match” on the other one.
e2ee.sas.done: Paired: the symbols were confirmed on both devices.
e2ee.sas.aborted: Pairing stopped, and nothing was paired. Start again, and pair only with the device in front of you.
